flags.why: In hầu tòa, hầu means to appear before a court, rather than to serve or wait on someone ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-h%E1%BA%A7u)).
flags.fix: Remove the hầu tòa example from this sense.

flags.why: Hầu does not mean 'later' or mark the future; its older connective uses express purpose or approaching a state ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-h%E1%BA%A7u)).
flags.fix: Remove this sense and its example.

flags.why: The common meaning 'to give an electric shock', as in bị điện giật, is missing ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/gi%E1%BA%ADt)).
flags.fix: verb | to give an electric shock | ex: Cẩn thận kẻo bị điện giật. = Be careful or you'll get an electric shock.

flags.why: The word meaning 'to tuck into a pocket or belt' is giắt, rather than dắt ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/gi%E1%BA%AFt)).
flags.fix: Remove this sense from dắt and place it under giắt, with the example: Anh ấy giắt cây bút vào túi áo.

flags.why: Ráng refers to the coloured sky glow at sunrise as well as sunset, so 'evening glow' incorrectly restricts its meaning ([dictionary](https://v2.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/R%C3%A1ng)).
flags.fix: coloured glow in the sky at sunrise or sunset
